blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill seeking the participation of civil society organizations (CSOs) in the preparation of the national budget was filed at the Senate on Monday. Senate finance committee chairperson, Sen. JV Ejercito, filed Senate Bill No. 2576, or the “Bantay Budget Act,” as the panel sought a consultation with several CSOs for the 2027 national budget. “In the interest of transparency, CSO participation shall be a component in the preparation and authorization of the annual national budget,” Ejercito wrote in the proposed measure.
